PhD Researcher at Oregon State University, Department of Fisheries, Wildlife, and
Conservation Sciences.

Researching freshwater ecosystems, biological invasions, predator–prey interactions,
and fish–crayfish ecology using field surveys, controlled experiments, behavioral
observations, and quantitative ecological methods.

::: {.keywords}
Aquatic Ecology · Fisheries Science · Invasive Species · Freshwater Ecology ·
Crayfish Ecology · Smallmouth Bass · Predator–Prey Interactions ·
Behavioral Ecology · R
:::

## What I work on

My dissertation examines ecological interactions among non-native Smallmouth
Bass (*Micropterus dolomieu*), native Signal Crayfish (*Pacifastacus
leniusculus*), and non-native Ringed Crayfish (*Faxonius neglectus*) in
Oregon river systems.

The work combines field diet and prey-availability sampling, controlled
predator–prey experiments, thermal-preference trials, video-based behavioral
analysis, and quantitative ecological methods to test whether interactions
among non-native species can alter the course of a biological invasion while
affecting the native species caught in between.

[Read more about the research →](research.qmd)

## Currently

- Completing the experimental and field components of my PhD dissertation at
  Oregon State University.
- Running laboratory predation trials examining Smallmouth Bass interactions
  with native Signal Crayfish and non-native Ringed Crayfish.
- Conducting thermal-preference and competition trials between Signal and
  Ringed Crayfish using controlled experiments and video-based behavioral
  analysis.
- Expanding field sampling across the Umpqua River system to characterize
  crayfish availability and thermal habitat.
- Building reproducible ecological data-analysis workflows in R, Quarto, Git,
  and GitHub.

## Geographic focus

**Oregon, USA** — Willamette River Basin, Umpqua River Basin, and Pacific
Northwest freshwater ecosystems.

**Saudi Arabia** — Freshwater biodiversity, marine and fisheries ecology,
aquatic conservation, and environmental monitoring.
